sourceArchive.reproduction: Create a checkout from originalCommit, overlay the corresponding original/src or prior/src entries from this archive, and symlink the same local node_modules. Verify the source hashes before using the benchmark command. Current working sources are the fixed version.

change.description: Independent thinking files use the existing readStateFile/writeStateFile functions directly. The prior temporary JsonStateStore was never reused, so its cache, batch queue and JSON deep copies provided no isolation value. Each read remains fresh and get/set retain Zod validation.
change.stateStoreChange: Export existing readStateFile/writeStateFile helpers. Function bodies and the shared JsonStateStore class are byte-for-byte unchanged.
notChanged: Bounded shared-state batching and acknowledgement semantics
File shape, envelope metadata, mode 0600, mkdir-before-write and atomic rename/cleanup

method.design: Two independently started processes per final scenario. Eight ABBA blocks per process, swapping root loading order in the second process. Six blocks per initial diagnosis. Each block has two measurements per implementation; percent changes compare block means and are summarized by their median. Blocks inside one process are not independent process replications; no p-value claim is made.
method.timing: Fixtures are prepared and optional forced GC runs before the clock. No render monkey-patching in timed measurements. Source/output hashing and precise V8 coverage run after timing. Process CPU includes worker/JIT/GC work and is secondary to paired elapsed time and deterministic work counts.
method.stream: One replay has sixty virtual one-second flushes. Microtask mode awaits the actual pending write chain and excludes OS scheduling; scheduled mode retains real setImmediate. One sample repeats a short replay 100 times or long/changing replay 10 times.
method.storage: Thirty file-backed thinking updates per replay. The memory backend models the same read/write/rename payloads without kernel latency; real temporary files are tested separately. Samples repeat memory thinking replays eight times. Shared state fixtures retain three bursts of twenty updates and twenty/five-thousand permissions.
method.counters: File operations use identical lightweight backend wrappers on both sides. Single replay render counts and synchronous cloneState precise-coverage counts are collected after timing. The latter include preparation and final readback. Other raw coverage entries are diagnostic only.
method.equivalence: All measurements and counter replays within each comparison have identical full output/state fingerprints. All two-process fingerprints agree. Warmups and setup are excluded from elapsed samples.
method.controlCalibration: Identical-source A/A runs show the measurement envelope. Real disk A/A paired changes ranged roughly -45% to +35%, so this environment cannot establish small native I/O latency differences.
method.limits: No concurrent local test/build jobs ran during measurements. Other desktop and filesystem activity is uncontrolled. The memory backend is a causal CPU-path control, not evidence of native disk durability or real Telegram latency.

interpretation.short: The previous apparent regression did not reproduce as an implementation cost: the paired pure processing path was about 42% faster than the original. Scheduled measurements are dominated by OS dispatch and sit within the identical-source noise envelope. No production short-stream code was changed in this repair.
interpretation.expanded: Prior-vs-original memory processing had a mixed-sign median change of about +0.7%; native file timing about +3.9%, both inside same-source control variation. The prior wall-time result cannot be reliably attributed to batching. Profiling nevertheless identified unnecessary generic state cloning in the independent-file path; this confirmed cost was removed.
interpretation.disk: Final pooled native disk medians and paired block medians do not agree in sign. Report both; do not claim a stable native disk latency speedup.

acceptance.expandedCpuPath: passed: all sixteen paired blocks improve; median local memory-backend processing time about 28% lower, synchronous cloneState calls 97 -> 0 per full replay lifecycle; validation and I/O counts preserved.
acceptance.shortStream: passed: pure processing benefit retained; scheduled results within calibrated noise; repaired source file is identical to prior accepted version.
acceptance.preservedBenefits: passed: long reasoning renders 61 -> 2; shared-state commits 60 -> 3 and bytes about 95% lower. Existing progress, batching and formatter source are unchanged apart from exporting file helpers.
acceptance.nativeDiskLatency: inconclusive for small latency changes; no stable latency improvement or regression claim. Functional real-file acceptance passed.
acceptance.outputAndErrorSemantics: passed: all fingerprints match; corruption is not overwritten, envelope fields survive, reads are fresh, schema validation and recovery are retained.
